text: So immediately the one that stands out as different would have to be number 12 just because, and that one I noticed that there aren't dots, also compared to the others it has one of the larger boxes, which I understand that number 5 does, but the red line that is in the box is positioned differently than it is in number 12, so that's why I think 12 stands out the most in regards to the blue box. The blue box is on the smaller side, I don't see many others that are the same size as it, nor with the blue dark line in it, in the same position.
